this is f*cking gold. a four-stroke engine has one job - suck, squeeze, bang, blow. fuel in, fire, piston down, exhaust out. break the loop and it’s just parts twitching.

four models, same prompt, same engine:
Claude Opus 5.5 · GPT-6 Astra · Gemini 4 Argon · Grok 4.7

three of them run the whole cycle - valves timing, combustion firing, crank turning, oil sitting in the pan. one just gestures at it, half the parts missing.

I didn’t touch a thing and I’m not scoring them. you’ve got eyes: which one’s a real working engine, and which one’s a sketch that forgot how engines work?

Opus, Astra, Gemini or Grok?

items.title: Bitter lesson on the robot side?
items.summary:
Bitter lesson on the robot side?

Foundation models and dedicated robot models might be getting one from frontier models like Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6 Astra, and Gemini Argon...(soon, Deepseek)

Fable 5.2 hit 64.9% on RoboDojo’s bimanual sim benchmark -- more than double its 5.1 score of 27.6%, ahead of GPT-6 Astra at 29.8%, and past a lot of systems built for robot control. The arms solve a puzzle cube, unscrew a bottle cap, fit a gear, and draw on tasks the model hadn’t been explicitly trained for.

Embodied work spent the last couple of years stacking specialized VLAs, WAMs, and manipulation data...General frontier models are now closing some of those gaps zero-shot with stronger reasoning and code agents.

items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

items.title: Live online certificate brings AI expertise to finance professionals | Cornell Chronicle
items.summary: That philosophy is reflected in the curriculum, which progresses from AI foundations and tools to financial use cases, responsible AI, industry applications and leadership. items.title: Đưa công nghệ đến gần hơn với người yếu thế
items.summary:
Cán bộ hướng dẫn công dân thao tác trên hệ thống dịch vụ công

Không chỉ hỗ trợ người dân hoàn thành thủ tục, cán bộ, chiến sĩ còn cố gắng sử dụng những cách giải thích đơn giản, dễ hiểu để người dân có thể tự thực hiện trong những lần tiếp theo. Đối với những người gặp khó khăn khi sử dụng công nghệ, cán bộ sẵn sàng hướng dẫn nhiều lần, giải đáp từng thắc mắc với thái độ tận tình, trách nhiệm. [...] Đối với những người thường xuyên sử dụng công nghệ, việc tạo tài khoản dịch vụ công, quét mã QR hoặc tải tài liệu đính kèm có thể thực hiện nhanh chóng. Tuy nhiên, với người cao tuổi và những người ít có điều kiện tiếp xúc với thiết bị điện tử, các thao tác này đôi khi gặp nhiều khó khăn.

Nhận thức được điều đó, cán bộ, chiến sĩ Công an xã Thuận An luôn chú trọng hướng dẫn cụ thể, kiên nhẫn giải thích từng bước để người dân hiểu và thực hiện đúng các thao tác cần thiết. [...] Những hoạt động hỗ trợ tuy giản dị nhưng mang ý nghĩa thiết thực, góp phần giúp người dân thuận lợi hơn trong giải quyết thủ tục hành chính, tiết kiệm thời gian, chi phí đi lại và từng bước nâng cao kỹ năng sử dụng dịch vụ công trực tuyến. Qua đó, Công an xã Thuận An tiếp tục đưa công nghệ đến gần hơn với người dân, nhất là những người còn gặp khó khăn trong tiếp cận công nghệ, để mọi người đều có cơ hội thụ hưởng những tiện ích của chuyển đổi số.

items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: This is f*cking insane. Geoffrey Hinton, the Nobel Prize winner they call the Godfather of AI, was asked what AI will do
items.summary:
This is f*cking insane. Geoffrey Hinton, the Nobel Prize winner they call the Godfather of AI, was asked what AI will do to jobs. His answer:

"For mundane intellectual labor, AI is just going to replace everybody"

In 93 seconds, he explains why this time is different: one person with an AI assistant will do the work of 10

The new jobs everyone promises? If AI can do all routine thinking work, he asks what jobs are left to create

Then the part that hits hardest. His niece answers complaint letters for a health service. Each one took her 25 minutes. Now AI writes it, she checks it, and it takes 5. So they need five times fewer of her

He agrees it won't be AI that takes your job, it'll be a person using AI. That just means far fewer people

10 People → 1 Person + AI → Agents → Harness → Loops → The One Who Stays
